# Pinned Agent Skills discovery fixtures

The implementation follows the Agent Skills Discovery RFC v0.2.0 at
[cloudflare/agent-skills-discovery-rfc@1bd1167](https://github.com/cloudflare/agent-skills-discovery-rfc/tree/1bd1167983fa5ac9cd47987710c525308eda1a98)
(updated 2026-03-12) and the [Agent Skills specification](https://agentskills.io/specification)
for `SKILL.md` frontmatter. The RFC's `$schema` URI is an opaque identifier and does not
resolve, and the RFC repository ships no JSON Schema, so `index.schema.json` is Nimbus's
own transcription of the RFC's field table. `two-skills.json` is Nimbus's expected index
for the unit-test fixture (one `skill-md` skill, one `archive` skill).

# Pinned discovery schemas

`ard-entry.schema.json` and `ai-catalog.schema.json` are copied unchanged from
[ards-project/ard-spec at b76f235a](https://github.com/ards-project/ard-spec/tree/b76f235a8f461876ad4f1e77abd0eb0eb302b48d/spec/schemas).
The accompanying spec is ARD v0.91, dated 2026-08-26. Its `ArdManifest` definition
accepts the AI Catalog 1.0 transport envelope, so both discovery URLs can serve
identical bytes. Tests validate both independently. The upstream Apache 2.0
license is included here. `docs-only.json` is Nimbus's own expected output.

# Pinned API catalog fixtures

The catalog follows [RFC 9727](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9727) (the
`/.well-known/api-catalog` well-known URI, the `api-catalog` link relation, and
the `https://www.rfc-editor.org/info/rfc9727` profile) serialised as an
[RFC 9264](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9264) JSON linkset. Neither RFC
publishes a JSON Schema, so `linkset.schema.json` is Nimbus's transcription of
RFC 9264 §4.2's serialisation rules, with the RFC 8631 relations the catalog
uses. `two-apis.json` is Nimbus's expected catalog for the unit-test record.
